integrity: Analytic proof and exact-rational standalone reproducer; finite calculations are not a substitute for infinite proofs.
scientific_limitations: The size lower bound assumes a tree, exactly one initial inactive bridge, permanent internal receptivity, and eventual common opinion. The five-node hidden-consensus construction requires one codimension-one initial-opinion constraint. Above threshold only first receptivity is classified. The historical literature search is not exhaustive.
title: A sharp five-vertex hidden-consensus bridge and its spectral receptivity threshold
